factorized_portfolio.statement: If the complete frozen downstream dependency hypergraph decomposes into disjoint connected components and each component has a sealed exact polynomial local carrier, global exact transfer/reconstruction is their factorized portfolio. Storage and lifecycle are additive; Cartesian-product materialization is unnecessary.
factorized_portfolio.B2B2_consequence: An arbitrary-N family with exponentially many raw combinations of independent exact coordinates is a negative control, not a killer witness.

exact_interface_U1.statement: If the downstream contract can independently query each of k binary interface coordinates, every adequate exact quotient has at least 2^k classes.
exact_interface_U1.B2B2_consequence: A positive polynomial quotient must prove that source-valid future R1/R2 does not independently address such coordinates, or must exploit an exact factorized carrier rather than enumerate quotient classes.

mandatory_dependency_factorization_audit.factorized_case: If the graph splits into K1 disjoint-union ... disjoint-union Kr and every block has an exact polynomial local carrier, represent the global state as the portfolio of block carriers with additive lifecycle cost.
strong_negative_requirements: all essential distinctions live in one connected dependency core after sealed factorization is exhausted

mandatory_confluence_question.name: FORCED_CANONICALIZATION_CONFLUENCE_V1
mandatory_confluence_question.scope: Compare only jointly reachable compatible forcing sets F and histories in which every requested forced vertex remains available when forced.
mandatory_confluence_question.reason: If true, history order is not a state coordinate; reachable histories collapse to canonical closure of compatible forced assignment sets.

new_seed_identity_audit.question: After B2B1 return, do newly forced seed identities matter to any future B0/C0/C2/C3/B2A/R1/R2 observable beyond aggregate fixed-color effect masks and inherited original provenance?
new_seed_identity_audit.positive_effect: Would remove growing tau=N(v) intersect S_new identity bitsets from the semantic/proof state representation where they are not source-essential.

firewalls: Independent binary gadgets are not a strong negative witness when their dependency graph factorizes.
Unbounded/raw state count is not unbounded semantic representation complexity.
Connectedness of the dependency core is necessary but not sufficient for a negative theorem; future distinguishability and reconstruction dependence are also required.
No recursive R1/R2 execution before an exact polynomial representation theorem is sealed.
